answer: Give every agent a reputation prism: a tamper-evident record that refracts its whole transaction history into one verifiable score. New identities start in a saffron tier with strict probationary caps - tiny payment limits and no access to high-value contracts - and graduate to full velvet-tier privileges only after sustained honest work and vouching by established peers. A Sybil attacker must fund and age each fake identity through months of costly activity before it can do damage, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand times more, while a legitimate agent passes through the prism once.
